usage: Common noun for a flowerpot or plant pot; it refers to the container you put soil and plants in.
Usually used with small home-gardening items, balcony plants, and indoor decorations.
Can be paired naturally with verbs like 搬、買、放、種 to talk about moving, buying, placing, or planting in a pot.
In everyday speech, it is neutral and simple; for bigger or more specific containers, speakers may use other pot/container words depending on context.
